summary: Coinmerce is crypto asset service provider in EU. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Dutch-founded crypto services company with over 150 staff in Schiphol-Rijk, covering brokerage, asset management and trading; not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Over 150 colleagues work from one office in Schiphol-Rijk, and the company calls transparency its core value with an open-door policy.
The group has three parts: crypto brokerage, asset management and proprietary trading.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, which makes visa sponsorship unlikely.

growth.text: Runs several legal entities: Coinmerce B.V., Coinmerce Earn B.V. and Stichting Coinmerce Vault.

worth_knowing.text: Registered as a crypto asset service provider in the EU, so work sits in a regulated financial setting.
